--- evidence/scripts/step28_balanced_pooling_run.py:595-614 ---
  595  def query_metrics(labels, scores):
  596      """Preserve per-query detail; aggregate agrees with the retained metric core."""
  597      left, right = np.triu_indices(28, 1)
  598      adjacency = np.full((len(labels), 28, 28), -np.inf)
  599      relevant = np.zeros((len(labels), 28, 28), np.uint8)
  600      adjacency[:, left, right] = adjacency[:, right, left] = scores
  601      relevant[:, left, right] = relevant[:, right, left] = labels
  602      order = np.argsort(-adjacency, axis=2, kind="stable")[:, :, :27]
  603      ranked = np.take_along_axis(relevant, order, axis=2)
  604      total = relevant.sum(2)
  605      if not np.all((total >= 1) & (total <= 2)):
  606          raise ValueError("Query relevance differs")
  607      ranks = np.arange(1, 28)
  608      values = [(np.cumsum(ranked, axis=2)*ranked/ranks).sum(2)/total, 1./(np.argmax(ranked, axis=2)+1)]
  609      values.extend(ranked[:, :, :k].sum(2)/total for k in (1, 3, 5, 10))
  610      discount = 1./np.log2(ranks+1)
  611      for k in (1, 3, 5, 10):
  612          ideal = np.asarray([discount[:min(k, int(n))].sum() for n in total.ravel()]).reshape(total.shape)
  613          values.append((ranked[:, :, :k]*discount[:k]).sum(2)/ideal)
  614      return np.stack(values, axis=2)

  648  def undefined_metrics(counts):
  649      """Only precision/MCC can be undefined for the contracted two-class groups."""
  650      mask = np.zeros((len(counts), 22), dtype=bool)
  651      for i, r in enumerate(counts):
  652          tp, fp, fn, tn = (r[k] for k in ("tp", "fp", "fn", "tn"))
  653          mask[i, 6] = tp+fp == 0
  654          mask[i, 11] = (tp+fp)*(tp+fn)*(tn+fp)*(tn+fn) == 0
  655      return mask

  658  def pooled_rates(counts):
  659      result = base.rates(counts)
  660      if result["tp"]+result["fp"] == 0:
  661          result.update(precision=None, precision_na_reason="No predicted positives")
  662      return result
  663  
  664  
  665  def summarize(matrix, domain_rows, draws):
  666      result = {}
  667      for i, d in enumerate("AB"):
  668          values = matrix[domain_rows[i]]
  669          result[d] = {}
  670          for j, k in enumerate(parent.metrics.COLUMNS):
  671              missing = int(np.isnan(values[:, j]).sum())
  672              if missing:
  673                  result[d][k] = {"mean": None, "conditional_95pct_interval": None,
  674                      "undefined_groups": missing, "total_groups": len(values),
  675                      "na_reason": "At least one required group operand is undefined; fixed groups retained."}
  676              else:
  677                  estimates = values[:, j][draws[:, i]].mean(1)
  678                  result[d][k] = {"mean": float(values[:, j].mean()),
  679                      "conditional_95pct_interval": np.quantile(estimates, [.025, .975]).tolist()}
  680      return result
